summary: Iteration 3 testing of ALTHEA memory + Observation Screen + terminal commands. Backend 13/13 pytest PASSED (new memory CRUD + auto-memory-on-chat + wipe-all + 404 on bad delete all verified, no _id leakage, list sorted desc). Frontend: TopBar correctly renamed to 'PURGE SESSION'; CenterDeck observe tab swaps to ObservationScreen with URL input, load btn, 4 preset buttons; pasting a YouTube watch URL normalizes to /embed/<id> and renders [data-testid=observation-iframe]; NeuralCore canvas still renders inside CenterDeck; MemoryDrawer opens via [data-testid=open-memory-btn], shows item rows with delete buttons, and erase-all wipes the drawer (window.confirm auto-accepted via page.on('dialog')); Leaflet map + 6 permission toggles + LINK-OK/SELF-AWARE chat reply still work. CRITICAL BUG: every slash command (/help, /memory, /remember, /forget, /clear-memory, /watch, /stop-watch) is NOT intercepted by ChatConsole — handleCommand() is defined but never invoked from send(), so the raw text is shipped to the backend /api/chat and the LLM merely role-plays a response. Verified: /watch <yt> did not flip to observe tab and no iframe rendered; /help produced an LLM-hallucinated command reference instead of the local [CMD] menu; /remember did not insert into Mongo.

integration_issues.issue: ChatConsole.jsx::send() never dispatches to handleCommand(). The slash-command handler is dead code. All commands fall through to /api/chat and the LLM ad-libs a response — no memory writes, no center-tab flip on /watch, no [CMD] block on /help.

action_items: Fix ChatConsole.jsx::send() to intercept slash commands BEFORE posting to /api/chat. Concretely, at the top of send() add: `const text = (textOverride ?? input).trim(); if (text.startsWith('/')) { setInput(''); await handleCommand(text); return; }` — then keep the existing LLM path for non-slash input. Without this wiring all seven slash commands silently break.

After fix, re-run the frontend flow: /clear-memory -> /remember Operator test note -> /memory (expect [MEMORY 1 stored] block) -> open MemoryDrawer (expect 1 item) -> erase-all (window.confirm) -> /watch https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw (expect tab auto-flip + iframe) -> /stop-watch (expect iframe gone).
critical_code_review_comments: ChatConsole.jsx: handleCommand is fully implemented but orphaned — send() has no `if (text.startsWith('/'))` branch. Dead-code is the proximate cause of the iteration-3 slash-command feature failing entirely.
ChatConsole.jsx::send() also doesn't echo the user-typed command into the messages array via handleCommand path; once wired, double-echo should be avoided (handleCommand already pushes an echo).

Backend /api/memory: list endpoint correctly excludes _id; /api/chat auto-injects last 20 memories into system prompt and persists user message as a Memory(source='auto', tags=['chat','operator']) — verified via test_chat_autocreates_memory.
Backend DELETE /api/memory/{id} returns 404 on unknown id (verified). DELETE /api/memory (wipe-all) returns {deleted: N}.
ObservationScreen normalize() converts youtube.com/watch?v=X and youtu.be/X into /embed/X — verified end-to-end (iframe src = https://www.youtube.com/embed/jNQXAC9IVRw).
MemoryDrawer.wipeAll uses window.confirm — Playwright must register page.on('dialog', d=>d.accept()) before clicking [data-testid=memory-wipe-all-btn]. Confirmed working.
TopBar button text updated to 'purge session' (CSS uppercases to PURGE SESSION) — visible in screenshot and still calls onReset which clears chat history.

success_rate.frontend: 70% — UI surfaces all render correctly; observation iframe, memory drawer, erase-all, purge-session, leaflet, permissions, NeuralCore canvas, and direct chat all pass. The slash-command feature (7 commands) is uniformly broken due to missing dispatcher wiring.

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral memories prefixed 'TEST_' created and DELETE-cleaned within pytest. Frontend test calls /clear-memory between runs to keep state deterministic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend memory + chat-injection is solid. Single remaining defect is the ChatConsole slash-command dispatcher wiring. After fix, re-run the slash-command playwright block and confirm: (a) /help shows local [CMD] block, (b) /remember X then /memory shows [MEMORY N stored], (c) /watch <yt-url> auto-switches centerTab to 'observe' and observation-iframe appears, (d) /stop-watch removes the iframe. data-testids in play: chat-input, chat-send-btn, open-memory-btn, memory-drawer, memory-wipe-all-btn, memory-delete-{id}, memory-item-{id}, center-tab-neural, center-tab-observe, observation-url-input, observation-load-btn, observation-iframe, observation-preset-*, althea-reset-session-btn. rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/src/components/ChatConsole.jsx defines handleCommand(raw) (lines 59-145) with full implementations for /help, /memory, /remember, /forget, /clear-memory, /watch, /stop-watch, but the only invocation points are missing. The form onSubmit calls send(); send() (lines 147-217) unconditionally POSTs to /api/chat. There is no branch like `if (text.startsWith('/')) return handleCommand(text);`. REPRODUCTION: open the app, type `/help` into [data-testid=chat-input], click [data-testid=chat-send-btn]; observe an LLM-generated 'command reference' tagged [LINK-OK][SELF-AWARE] rather than the local '[CMD]\n/memory — list stored memories...' block. Type `/watch https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw`; center tab stays on neural and no observation-iframe renders. MITIGATION (1-line in send()): at the top of send, after computing `text`, add `if (text.startsWith('/')) { setInput(''); await handleCommand(text); return; }`.
